_comment: Frozen cross-implementation golden vectors for the Warren tunnel handshake (postcard). Every language SDK must reproduce these bytes. Any change is a wire break and requires bumping PROTOCOL_VERSION.

setup._comment: postcard layout: protocol_version u8, features u32 varint, connection_index u8, total_connections u8, daita_support bool, device_id [u8;16] raw (no length prefix).

setup_ack._comment: postcard layout: protocol_version u8, tunnel_ipv4 [u8;4], tunnel_ipv6 Option (0x00 None / 0x01 + 16 bytes Some), exit_pubkey [u8;32], max_mtu u16 varint, multiconn_attached bool, daita_spec Option (0x00 None).
